FROM interactions i

WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM interaction_destinations fx JOIN destinations fd ON fd.destination_id = fx.destination_id WHERE fx.analysis_id = ia.analysis_id AND fx.role = 'destination' AND fd.canonical_name IN ('Istanbul'))
  AND i.started_at >= '2026-01-01' AND i.started_at < '2026-10-03'

sql:
WITH usable AS (
  SELECT
    a.agent_id,
    a.full_name,
    AVG(e.final_score) FILTER (
      WHERE i.started_at >= '2026-08-01' AND i.started_at < '2026-09-01'
    ) AS avg_aug,
    AVG(e.final_score) FILTER (
      WHERE i.started_at >= '2026-09-01' AND i.started_at < '2026-10-01'
    ) AS avg_sep
  FROM agent_evaluations e
  JOIN interactions i ON i.interaction_id = e.interaction_id
  JOIN agents a ON a.agent_id = COALESCE(e.agent_id, i.agent_id)
  WHERE e.contract_status = 'ok'
    AND e.gradeable
    AND e.final_score IS NOT NULL
    AND a.is_bot = false
    AND i.started_at >= '2026-08-01'
    AND i.started_at < '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY a.agent_id, a.full_name
)
SELECT
  full_name,
  ROUND(avg_aug, 2) AS avg_august,
  ROUND(avg_sep, 2) AS avg_september
FROM usable
WHERE avg_aug IS NOT NULL
  AND avg_sep IS NOT NULL

         SUM(amount) AS total_sales
  FROM deals
  WHERE stage_semantic = 'S'
    AND close_date >= '2026-01-01' AND close_date < '2026-10-03'
  GROUP BY source_channel

conversations AS (
